welcome.subject: Welcome to SaaS Skeleton!
welcome.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your account has been created. Welcome aboard!

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.body:
Hi {{name}},

We received a request to reset your password. Click the link below to choose a new one. This link expires in 60 minutes and can only be used once.

{{link}}

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password won't change.

emailChangeRequested.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailChangeRequested.body:
Hi {{name}},

Confirm this address to finish changing the email on your account. This link expires in 60 minutes and can only be used once.

{{link}}

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

emailChanged.subject: Your account email address was changed
emailChanged.body:
Hi {{name}},

The email address on your account was just changed. If this was you, no action is needed.

If you didn't make this change, please contact your workspace administrator immediately.
